According to the liner notes for the band's debut album "The Chinkees Are Coming!" , the music was recorded by members of the band Tuesday with vocals provided by Mike Park.  Subsequent albums were recorded all or in part by members Park, Miya Osaki, Greg Alesandro, Jason Thinh, and Steve Choi, as well as "guest" musicians, including Slapstick and Tuesday drummer Rob Kellenberger and Link 80's Steve Borth, often with members trading and playing different instruments than listed. Zoetrope (album) | Zoetrope is an album released in 2002 by the dark ambient musician Lustmord on the Nextera record label.  The album is a soundtrack to the experimental psychological horror film of the same name.

The film's soundtrack was composed by the electronic musician Thomas Bangalter, best known as half of the Daft Punk duo.

Sufficiency of disclosure | Sufficiency of disclosure or enablement is a patent law requirement according to which a patent application must disclose a claimed invention in sufficient detail for the notional person skilled in the art to carry out that claimed invention. Photoelectrochemical oxidation | Photoelectrochemical oxidation (PECO) is the process by which incident light enables a semiconductor material to promote a catalytic oxidation reaction. PECO has been used for the detoxification of air and water, hydrogen production, and other applications.
